# bind_id: # The help registry: one row per key the help panes describe. bind_id is the
# modifiers joined with + and the key name as Hyprland prints it (SUPER+SHIFT+S,
# F1). pane is one of hypr browser shell editor system. action_type says what
# action_value is (docs/i18n-schema.md): exec runs it through Hyprland, dispatch
# is a dispatcher call, doc is a path under docs/. label_key is the i18n key of
# the description. Every hypr row must match an annotated bind in the Hyprland
# template and every annotated bind a row here: scripts/check-help-registry.sh.

action_value: cliphist list | rofi -dmenu -i -p Clipboard | cliphist decode | wl-copy
